title: Public Hearing on the draft RTS on Home-Host Supervisory Cooperation

paras.text: In this Public Hearing, AMLA is consulting on proposed draft Regulatory Technical Standards (RTS), which set out a simple, proportionate and efficient framework for cooperation between home and host supervisors of cross-border groups of obliged entities.

The draft RTS address supervisors of groups of obliged entities operating across borders in the financial and non-financial sectors, and form part of a broader cooperation framework that also includes AML/CFT supervisory colleges and cooperation guidelines. They specify the respective roles of home and host supervisors and establish practical arrangements for effective day-to-day cooperation.
The consultation paper is available here .

AMLA welcomes participation from all interested stakeholders and invites comments on the specific questions in section 5.2 of the consultation paper . This hearing is the designated channel for feedback; no written contributions can be accepted.
